verdict.rationale: Tracking whether and when recipients opened a sent email is a fair question for an email product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documentation of read receipts or open tracking. The nearby material does not cover recipient opens: mailbox-change push notifications, Undo Send, and IMAP read-status sync all concern the user's own mailbox.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can see whether and when recipients opened my email
